Subject: Project Outline For Review
From: morgan@example.com
To: agent@example.com
Message-ID: <proj001@example.com>

Hello, I need a condensed summary of this entire outline for my notes. Below is the full breakdown:

Project Name: Example Initiative
Goal: Create a small scale prototype to test a concept.

Phase One (Research): Conduct surveys amongst a test audience, compile all responses, categorize by priority, and cross reference any reoccuring feedback. Estimated timeline: 14 days. Required resources: survey template, response spreadsheet, and time to interview a subset of responses.

Phase Two (Drafting): Utilizing all compiled research, create a barebones layout. This includes a user flow chart, a list of required functions, a rough draft of text content, and a checklist of all interactive elements. Estimated timeline: 21 days. Required resources: flowcharting space, text drafts, and feedback from phase one.

Phase Three (Testing): Have a small group interact with the prototype. Track all clicks, any points of confusion, time spent per page, and overall satisfaction based off of a rating system from one to ten. Compile all bugs into a tracking list with reproduction steps. Estimated timeline: 10 days. Required resources: testing group, bug tracker, and a feedback form.

Phase Four (Finalization): Implement any fixes that were deemed high priority from phase three, test said fixes, create a finalized change log, and compile all final documentation for hand off. Estimated timeline: 7 days. Required resources: finalized checklist and documentation template.

Additional Notes: All assets must be stored in one central location, weekly check ins will be held every Wednesday at 3 PM, and any roadblocks must be reported at least 24 hours prior to said check in. 

Can you please condense this into a digestible summary for me?

-- 
Morgan
